title: Replace status dropdowns with ON/OFF checkboxes and make notes always open

requirements.text: Replace the status dropdown selector in TaskCard component with a functional checkbox that toggles between completed (ON) and not completed (OFF) states for each milestone task

quotes: no veo que tenga checkboxes, nose como funciona el sistema de tracking de progreso (es imperativo que cada hito tenga un checkbox funcional ON/OFF)

acceptanceCriteria: Each task card displays a checkbox instead of the status dropdown
Clicking the checkbox toggles between checked (completed) and unchecked (not completed)
The checkbox visually indicates the task's completion state
Checkbox changes persist and update the backend task status

requirements.text: Update the backend Task status model to support binary completion tracking compatible with checkbox interface (completed vs not completed)

quotes: es imperativo que cada hito tenga un checkbox funcional ON/OFF

acceptanceCriteria: Backend accepts and stores binary completion status for tasks
Status updates from checkbox interactions are properly saved
Migration handles conversion of existing three-state status to binary completed/not-completed

requirements.text: Update progress calculation logic in progressUtils.ts to work with binary checkbox completion status instead of three-state dropdown status
acceptanceCriteria: Progress calculations correctly count checked tasks as complete
Progress calculations correctly count unchecked tasks as incomplete
Phase and milestone progress indicators update accurately based on checkbox states
Overall project progress reflects binary completion tracking

requirements.text: Remove the collapsible/expandable behavior from the notes section in TaskCard so that notes are always visible and editable by default

quotes: las notas deben ser abiertas para agregar mas, estan cerradas ahora

acceptanceCriteria: Notes section is always visible for each task without requiring expansion
Notes textarea is immediately accessible for editing
No collapse/expand toggle button or state for notes section
Users can add and edit notes without any extra clicks

constraints: Preserve existing task data during status model transition from three-state to binary
Maintain Spanish language labels throughout the interface
Keep the fixed start date of February 20, 2026 for all date calculations
nonGoals: Changing the overall phase and milestone structure
